items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: A critical zero-day vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations. Adobe is aware of active exploitation in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including issues that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Customer Session Identity Switch)
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without user interaction. This vulnerability has been added to the CISA KEV catalog due to active exploitation.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Security Feature Bypass in B2B)
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in the Amasty Order Attributes extension allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: SessionReaper: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE) and Session Takeover
items.summary: A critical vulnerability in Magento and Adobe Commerce that allows customer account takeover and unauthenticated remote code execution under certain conditions. Active exploitation has been observed since October 2025.
